partially_covered.missing: No explicit property to enumerate all displayed organization info; relies on generic hasName, hasAddress, hasIdentifier, but lacks grouping or completeness constraints.
No explicit encoding of mandatory/optional fields or SHACL constraints for file validity; only implicit via class structure.

cq_coverage.details: Most CQs are fully addressed by the ontology structure, including roles, items, prices, and invoice metadata. Partial gaps exist for completeness of organization display info and explicit file validity requirements.

issues: Non-OWL2 datatype: xsd:date used in hasDate (should be xsd:dateTime)
No SHACL or OWL cardinality constraints to enforce required elements

strengths: Good use of pivot classes for roles and line items
weaknesses: No explicit cardinality or SHACL constraints for validation

likely_oops_pitfalls: P4 (Missing domain or range in some properties, but not observed here)
reasoner_risks: Hermit and Pellet will fail on xsd:date datatype

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Replace all uses of xsd:date in data properties (notably hasDate) with xsd:dateTime to ensure OWL 2 DL compatibility.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Ontology will load in all standard OWL 2 reasoners and pass validator checks.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: For CQ13, explicitly model mandatory/optional fields and validation constraints using SHACL or OWL cardinalities to represent file format validity.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Supports automated validation and completeness queries.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: For CQ5, aggregate organization display info via a grouping class or view, or document all relevant properties for organization display.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Improved queryability and documentation for organization info.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Introduce General Class Axioms (GCAs) to define complex classes (e.g., an InvoiceMessage with both Buyer and Seller assignments).
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Enables richer inferencing and semantic validation.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Expand disjointness axioms to further unrelated classes (e.g., AgentRole disjointWith Segment).

summary: The ontology provides strong coverage for UN/EDIFACT invoice semantics, roles, and structure, with good use of pivot classes and restrictions. The main blocking issue is the use of xsd:date, which is not OWL 2 compliant and must be replaced with xsd:dateTime. CQ coverage is high, but explicit modeling of validation constraints and richer axiomatization would further improve quality and usability.
